name: Nest Basis Vault
oneLiner: nBASIS is Nest's NAV basis vault combining USTB Treasury and Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund (USCC, formerly Superstate USCC); NAV varies and is not a fixed 1:1 peg.
collateral: Bitwise Crypto Carry Fund shares (USCC, formerly Superstate USCC), USTB Treasury-fund shares and liquid USDC/USDT/pUSD balances identified by Nest's exact positions feed. Allocation weights vary; historical static percentages are not a current portfolio observation.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base and drifts with the basis-trade strategy NAV; primary mint and redemption occur through Nest at vault NAV against USDC and pUSD

notices.title: Active strategy, not par stablecoin
notices.message: nBASIS runs a basis-trade strategy whose value drifts with funding-rate performance. It is closer in profile to Midas mRe7YIELD than to a 1:1 stablecoin, and Pharos lists it because its primary reference is the U.S. dollar.

notices.title: Arc-only issuance
notices.message: Nest now issues and redeems nBASIS only on Arc (chainId 5042) against USDC; positions on earlier chain deployments are preserved and viewable on Plume Vaults.

listingStatusReview.reason: NAV-priced Nest crypto basis-trade vault share routing into USCC and USTB, not a fixed-par stablecoin; no active stablecoin links it as reserve backing (listing policy 2.0).
